outline:
本課程教導學生認識國內外工商環境的演變，目前的情況與未來的發展趨勢。課程內容將探討（1）大中華圈（台灣、香港、新加坡、大陸）華人企業的管理哲學，（2）西方工商管理思潮的演變與對亞洲企業經營的影響，（3）製商整合與產業電子化，（4）網路世代的企業經營型態，（5）二十一世紀企業永續生存的要件
This course teaches the students recognize the changing business environment for both domestic and international markets, its current situation and future prospect. The course will cover (1) Chinese management philosophy in Greater China (Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Mainland China), (2) Revolution of Western management concepts and their influence to the business management in Asia, (3) Integration of manufacturing and business and electronic networking of business, (4) Managing business in an internet society, and (5) The criteria for long-term survival of a business in the 21st century.
